title: New developer: Konstantin Mosesov
html:
Kamailio project is pleased to announce that a new person joined the development team, getting GIT write access to repository: Konstantin Mosesov – he has contributed patches to app_python and joins the team to help maintaining and developing this module.

His git commit id is: ez

Our warm welcome and looking forward to future work within the project!
